valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date of Nov 2027, in USD per ADS/share). At Q3 2026, diluted share count was 64.89M, cash and current financial assets were $3.7B, and Q3 2026 diluted EPS was $7.80 on $1.721B product net sales (+54% YoY).

bear.driver: Slower Vyvgart CIDP/gMG penetration, competitive FcRn pressure, and elevated R&D/SG&A spend above $4B

base.driver: Continued Vyvgart growth in gMG and CIDP, pediatric gMG approval (Feb 2027 PDUFA), and H2 2027 autoinjector launch

bull.driver: Stronger-than-expected Vyvgart label expansion (oMG, IMNM) plus positive empasiprubart MMN Phase 3 data

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $33.40, the $960.04 close implies 28.7x; at 32x, the close implies $30.00 FY2027 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $33.40 (3.5 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Vyvgart global quarterly net sales growth and Phase 3 empasiprubart MMN (EMPASSION) topline readout
valuation.next_disclosure: Phase 3 empasiprubart MMN (EMPASSION) topline data expected December 2026; Q4/FY2026 earnings in February 2027

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 22, 2026 ($1.721B product net sales, +54% YoY; $7.80 diluted EPS), named analyst updates were mixed: Baird raised its target to $861 (Neutral), Wells Fargo adjusted to $1,336 (Overweight), and Morgan Stanley trimmed to $1,130 (Overweight) on November 13. Bullish targets ($1,336-$1,400) sit 25-31 pp above our $1,068.80 base case, reflecting higher FY2027 non-GAAP EPS assumptions (e.g., TD Cowen at $38.65) and 35x+ multiples.
